name: Sustainable Forests and Communities Initiative
summary: Grants of up to US$50,000 a year to charities and public bodies in forested US communities that combine forest conservation or ecological restoration with sustainable forest-based jobs and community consensus-building.

geography.label: Forested communities in the United States

reporting: Metrics on qualitative and quantitative outcomes at the end of each grant period.
